svg.title: The workshop route: nine steps, four deploys
svg.desc: Steps 0 to 8 in a row. Deploy 1 and Deploy 2 happen in Step 3, Deploy 3 in Step 4, Deploy 4a and 4b in Step 6. Deploys 1, 3 and 4a build a container image and take about 6 minutes each. Terraform in Step 1 takes 6 to 12 minutes.
